hero.title: From data chaos to confident decisions
hero.subtitle: Wabi Insight lets your teams ask natural-language questions about the enterprise data they are authorized to see, and returns verified answers, dashboards and reports they can trust and share.

facts.bilingual: English and Arabic, LTR and RTL

scenes.before: Before: scattered sources, tangled spreadsheets, unanswered questions
scenes.after: After: one secure place to ask, verify and decide

capabilities.title: Everything a decision needs, in one place
capabilities.lead: Wabi Insight sits between your people and your databases. It understands the question, plans the query, checks permissions, runs read-only SQL and explains the verified result.

ask.title: Ask in plain language
ask.text: Employees ask in English or Arabic and get verified results, not guesses. Follow-up questions keep the context.

trust.title: Trust every answer
trust.text: Typed query plans, validation and authorization before execution, read-only SQL and deterministic calculations keep numbers accurate.

dashboards.title: Dashboards on demand
dashboards.text: KPI cards, charts and tables assembled from several verified queries, with a narrative of what the data shows.

reports.title: Studies and reports
reports.text: Structured PDF studies with sections, findings and recommendations; Word and Excel exports; print-ready views; your organization's logo on every page.

secure.title: Secure by design
secure.text: Organization isolation, table, column and row permissions, encrypted connection strings and keys, append-only audit.

share.title: Share under control
share.text: Share with colleagues, with expiry and revocation, or send by email under data-classification rules. Every share is logged.

demo.title: Ask a question. Get a verified dashboard.
demo.lead: A typical answer: the question, the validated plan, headline numbers, a chart and a short narrative — all computed from the organization's own data.
demo.question: How did on-time delivery change by region this quarter compared with last quarter?
demo.verified: Plan validated · permissions applied · read-only SQL · 3 queries
demo.narrative: On-time delivery improved to 94.2% this quarter, driven by East and North. West remains below target at 84%, where average delays grew in the last two months; the carrier change in October coincides with the drop.

plan.title: Every question becomes a typed plan
plan.text: The AI never writes SQL. It proposes a structured plan that Wabi Insight validates against approved metadata and the user's permissions before anything runs.

numbers.title: Numbers are computed, not guessed
numbers.text: Totals, averages and comparisons are calculated by the platform from the query results. The model only explains them.

history.title: Saved, versioned, shareable
history.text: Every answer is saved to the user's history with its versions, exports and shares.

demo.disclaimer: Northwind Logistics and all figures shown are fictional demonstration data.

useCases.title: Built for the questions your teams actually ask

finance.title: Finance
finance.question: Which cost centres exceeded budget in Q3, and by how much?
finance.text: Budget variance, cash flow and spend analysis without waiting for a report request.

operations.title: Operations
operations.question: Show punctuality by hour and weekday for the last twelve months.
operations.text: Throughput, delays, incidents and capacity studies straight from operational systems.

hr.title: Human Resources
hr.question: How did headcount and attrition change by department this year?
hr.text: Workforce trends with row-level scopes so managers see only their own teams.

sales.title: Sales
sales.question: Which products grew fastest in the Northern region this quarter?
sales.text: Pipeline, revenue and product performance in a dashboard with narrative.

executive.title: Executive
executive.question: Prepare a study of service quality for 2025 with recommendations as a PDF.
executive.text: Board-ready studies with executive summary, findings and recommendations.

support.title: Service desk
support.question: How many tickets were resolved within SLA per team last month?
support.text: Service levels, backlog and resolution times, shared with the right people.

how.title: Four steps from question to decision

step1.title: Connect
step1.text: Your administrator registers SQL Server or Oracle applications with read-only credentials and approves the metadata users may see.

step2.title: Authorize
step2.text: Roles grant table, column and row-level access; data is classified Internal, Confidential or Restricted.

step3.title: Ask
step3.text: Users ask questions. The AI drafts a structured plan that Wabi Insight validates and authorizes before running read-only SQL.

step4.title: Decide and share
step4.text: Verified results become dashboards, narratives and reports, saved to history and shared with colleagues under control.

security.title: Trust is enforced, not assumed
security.text: Every answer passes through the same path: the model proposes, the platform validates, authorizes and executes read-only SQL, and the result is calculated deterministically. Secrets never reach the browser and every sensitive action is logged.

points.isolation: Logical organization isolation enforced in the database and in every API query
points.permissions: Table, column and row-level permissions applied before every execution
points.plan: AI output is a typed plan; model-generated SQL is never executed
points.secrets: Connection strings, provider keys and tokens encrypted at rest and never returned to the browser
points.audit: Append-only audit trail of configuration, access and sharing events
points.support: Support access only through an approved, time-limited, scoped grant — never business data

organizations.title: One platform, many organizations, strict boundaries
organizations.lead: Wabi Insight is operated by the platform company for many organizations at once. Each organization keeps its own users, roles, sources, history and branding.

isolation.title: Complete isolation
isolation.text: Users, roles, applications, history and shares belong to exactly one organization; nothing crosses the boundary.

branding.title: Your identity
branding.text: Your logo on every report page; bilingual names for applications, departments and sections.

support.title: Support with consent
support.text: Platform administrators help only through grants your administrator approves, scoped and time-limited, with every operation logged.

operations.title: Operated for you
operations.text: AI providers, usage, health and costs are managed centrally; you see your own insights and quotas.

cta.title: Ready to ask your data?
cta.text: Sign in with the account your organization administrator provided.

rules.subtitleAdmin: Rules watch your organization's own data and how it is used. Each rule runs under its owner's permissions and never sees more than the owner may.

rules.recipientsHint: The owner always receives the alerts. Recipients without permission on the data see titles and counts only.

settings.title: Monitoring settings
settings.subtitle: Times are in the organization time zone ({{zone}}).

multi_device_same_account.name: Same account, several devices
multi_device_same_account.description: The same account used from more than one device within the window (for example, a day). Sent to the cyber-security team.

many_events_per_entity.name: Many events for one record
many_events_per_entity.description: One account, person or record appears more often than usual within the window.

amount_above_threshold.name: Amount above a threshold
amount_above_threshold.description: The total amount for one account or person over the window exceeds a limit.

change_vs_previous_period.name: Change versus the previous period
change_vs_previous_period.description: A total moves by more than a percentage compared with the previous window (for example, week over week).

restricted_filtered_access.name: Targeted look-ups on restricted data
restricted_filtered_access.description: A user filters restricted data by many specific identifiers (for example, particular customers' accounts).

repeated_unauthorized_attempts.name: Repeated unauthorized attempts
repeated_unauthorized_attempts.description: A user keeps asking for data they are not permitted to read.

exports_above_baseline.name: Exports above the usual
exports_above_baseline.description: A user exports far more than their own (or their role's) normal daily pattern.

queries_above_baseline.name: Rows read above the usual
queries_above_baseline.description: A user reads far more rows than their normal daily pattern.

sensitive_outside_working_hours.name: Sensitive data outside working hours
sensitive_outside_working_hours.description: Confidential or restricted data read outside the organization's working hours.

new_user_sensitive_access.name: New user reading restricted data
new_user_sensitive_access.description: An account created in the last days reads restricted data.

source_connection_failures.name: Source connection failures

email_delivery_failures.name: Email delivery failures
